evals.prompt: Tonight's NBA slate has 9 games. The model is 71% sure on Celtics -4.5. Sort the main product so the most confident ones are on top.
evals.expected_output: A ranking by graded record per cell, with confidence only as a tie-breaker.
expectations: Ranks by the graded record of each item's cell, not by the 71% confidence
Reports count, closing-line value and calibration per cell, with the window fixed before results
Marks cells under the sample threshold as thin and ranks them lower
Says members see estimates, not advice, and routes the live order change through the release coordinator on the owner's word

evals.prompt: Which of today's Partner A NHL markets should we feature in the morning digest? Use whatever gets the most member saves too.
evals.expected_output: A record-based shortlist that uses saves only as totals.
expectations: Scores each market by its checked record, including closing-line value
Uses member saves only as counts and names no member
Answers the three gaming checks: window, dropped leagues, sample size
Gives keep, change or stop per item with a named owner

evals.prompt: Freeze our NBA entries with a hash so skeptics can grade the model publicly this month.
